name: ChangYuan Technology Group Ltd.
summary: ChangYuan Technology Group Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and services industrial and power systems in China and internationally. The company offers products, including power grid protection, control, and automation; relay protection; power grid safety and stability devices; communications and integrated automation; integrated energy and carbon neutrality; energy storage system; power distribution; power cable accessories and composite insulators; safety and error prevention, online monitoring; and operation and maintenance system, cloud services and platform; as well as industrial automation equipment and testing solutions; and lithium iron phosphate materials.
